description.narrative: The development impact thesis of this transaction derives from that of the ERA Program for Ukraine. As such, the Project is expected to increase access to quality connectivity for individuals and businesses through a capex program supported by operational efficiencies and synergies generated by the merger between two telecom operators with large overlapping networks and operations. Beyond the Project, the transaction is expected to strengthen the resilience of the telecom sector in Ukraine, by supporting the consolidation of the broadband market through the merger between a leading fixed broadband operator and the third largest mobile operator

The proposed investment will support NJJ Holding (an investment company owned by Xavier Niel, a global telecom, media, and technology investor) and Horizon Capital (a Private Equity fund manager with a focus on Ukraine and an existing IFC client) with their plans to merge Lifecell Group ( https://www.lifecell.ua ) and Datagroup-Volia ( https://www.datagroup.ua ) creating a telecom operator in Ukraine (the Group). IFC is considering providing a corporate finance debt facility of up to $218 million to support the merger. The transaction will enable capital expenditures related to upgrading and modernizing the mobile and fixed networks, increasing network resilience, service quality, coverage, and energy efficiency. Datagroup-Volia (DGV) is a fixed-line, satellite, pay TV, and retail broadband services provider. Lifecell Group provides mobile communication and data transfer services, mobile tower operations, and outsourcing call centers, through three separate entities (Urktower, Global Bilgi & Lifecell; collectively, Lifecell Group or LC). Once combined, the Group will be one of Ukraines largest fixed and mobile convergent operators, providing mobile connectivity to c. 10 million subscribers and covering c. 4 million homes with fixed broadband. The infrastructure comprises base stations, towers, backbone and a last-mile fiber network. The Group will also operate retail stores, office space, data centers, and outsourcing call centers in Ukraine. The project is expected to be supported by Blended Finance contributors under the ERA Program for Ukraine- France and European Commission-Ukraine Investment Framework, as described in the Blended Finance Section.
